name: rokcso-pi-volcengine-agent-plan
description: A pi extension that registers Volcengine Ark Agent Plan as a custom OpenAI-compatible provider, with verified thinking-depth support for domestic coding models (Doubao, DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, MiniMax).
